war_summary: On Day 104 of War 139, intense combat is centered along both the central mainland fronts and active island/coastal theaters. Endless Shore and Godcrofts remain severe hotspots with ongoing base captures, neutralizations, and heavy casualty rates, while Stema Landing has experienced a recent flurry of base neutralizations and flips. Along the inland corridor, Callahan's Passage and Marban Hollow are witnessing massive casualty spikes exceeding thousands per hour as both factions contest key transit hubs and fortifications, complemented by persistent island engagements across Oarbreaker.
